demo.note: 7 records but only 3 different classes.

cards.t: Learning SQL step by step (The Secret of Learning SQL)
cards.tz: 逐步学 SQL（The Secret of Learning SQL）
cards.en:
💡 The idea
SQL is learned like swimming: by doing it. Reading alone is not enough; you must run queries and compare the result with what you expected.

📏 The rule

  1. Beginner: run each new statement, compare result with the table, study textbook examples.
  2. Exam questions: Level 1 check answers one by one by trial; Level 2 answer a group first, then check them all. Questions without sample data → make your own sample data.
  3. Advanced, 3 common types: state the purpose of a statement; write the output on given data; write an alternative SQL with the same output.

📝 Exam wording
For 'state the purpose', describe the result in plain words, e.g. 'To list the names of students in class 1B in ascending order of class number.'
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
SQL 像游泳，要动手学。只读不够，必须执行查询，比较结果和预期。

📏 规则

  1. 初学：执行每个新语句，对照表格，研究课本例子。
  2. 考题：Level 1 逐题试；Level 2 先答一组再一次检查。没有样本数据就自己造。
  3. 进阶三类：写语句的目的；写输出；写另一句结果相同的 SQL。

📝 考试写法
写目的要用平常话描述结果，例如 'To list the names of students in class 1B in ascending order of class number.'

ex.q: State the purpose of SELECT DISTINCT CLASS FROM STUDENT WHERE CNO > 10.
ex.a: To list, without repetition, the classes that have at least one student with class number greater than 10.
ex.az: 列出（不重复）有学号大于 10 学生的班别。

ex.q: Write an alternative SQL with the same output as SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT WHERE NOT (CLASS = '1B').
ex.a: SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS <> '1B' (both return Ada, Gabe, Dio, Ben).
ex.az: WHERE CLASS <> '1B'。

ex.q: Common mistake: describing purpose as 'It selects NAME from STUDENT where CLASS is 1B.'
ex.a: That just reads the code aloud and earns little. Describe the meaning: 'To list the names of all students in class 1B.'
ex.az: 只是照读代码。要写意义。

code.src:
SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT WHERE NOT (CLASS = '1B');
SELECT NAME FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS <> '1B'
code.out:
NAME
----
Ada 
Gabe
Dio 
Ben 
NAME
----
Ada 
Gabe
Dio 
Ben
code.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(16), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT);
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','1A',1),('03496','Clem','1B',15),('03505','Eva','1B',28),('03506','Gabe','1C',NULL),('03510','Finn','1B',7),('03513','Dio','1C',13),('03517','Ben','1A',9);

cards.en:
💡 The idea
UPDATE is correcting a form with correction tape. WHERE says which forms; SET says which box gets what new value.

📏 The rule
UPDATE table SET f1 = v1, f2 = v2 WHERE condition

  • Only matching records change.
  • Several fields: separate with commas, one SET only.
  • New value may use the old one: SET PRICE = PRICE * 0.9.

📝 Exam wording
UPDATE changes data in existing records. To update multiple fields, separate the assignments with commas.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
UPDATE 像用涂改带改表格。WHERE 说改哪些记录；SET 说哪一格改成什么。

📏 规则
UPDATE 表 SET f1 = v1, f2 = v2 WHERE 条件

  • 只改符合条件的记录。
  • 多栏用逗号分隔，只写一个 SET。
  • 新值可用旧值计算：SET PRICE = PRICE * 0.9。

📝 考试写法
UPDATE changes data in existing records. 多栏更新用逗号分隔。

ex.q: Rename student 03517 (Ben) to Bob.
ex.a: UPDATE STUDENT SET NAME = 'Bob' WHERE SID = '03517'
ex.az: WHERE SID='03517'，SET NAME='Bob'。

ex.q: Student 03517 becomes Buzz and moves to 1B.
ex.a: UPDATE STUDENT SET NAME = 'Buzz', CLASS = '1B' WHERE SID = '03517'
ex.az: 一个 SET，两项用逗号。

ex.q: Common mistake: SET NAME = 'Buzz' AND CLASS = '1B'
ex.a: AND makes a true/false expression: NAME gets the result of ('Buzz' AND CLASS='1B') — in SQLite that is 0 — and CLASS is unchanged! Use a comma.
ex.az: AND 变成逻辑运算：NAME 变成 0，CLASS 不变！要用逗号。

notes.t: NAME became 0 and CLASS is still 1A.

code.out:
SID    NAME  CLASS
-----  ----  -----
03517  0     1A   
SID    NAME  CLASS
-----  ----  -----
03517  Buzz  1B
code.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(16), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT);
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','1A',1),('03496','Clem','1B',15),('03505','Eva','1B',28),('03506','Gabe','1C',NULL),('03510','Finn','1B',7),('03513','Dio','1C',13),('03517','Ben','1A',9);

demo.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(16), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT);
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','1A',1),('03496','Clem','1B',15),('03505','Eva','1B',28),('03506','Gabe','1C',NULL),('03510','Finn','1B',7),('03513','Dio','1C',13),('03517','Ben','1A',9);
demo.query: UPDATE STUDENT SET NAME = 'Buzz', CLASS = '1B' WHERE SID = '03517'; SELECT * FROM STUDENT
demo.note: Only the record with SID 03517 changes.

cards.t: Use a unique field as the criterion
cards.en:
💡 The idea
If a teacher says 'Chan, come out!' three Chans might stand up. Calling a student number picks exactly one person. Same in SQL.

📏 The rule

  • To change one specific record, put the primary key (or another unique field) in WHERE: WHERE SID = '03517'.
  • Names can repeat, so WHERE NAME = 'Ben' may hit the wrong student.
  • When the task targets a group (all 1B students), use the group field.

📝 Exam wording
SID is an identity number, which is supposed to be unique for each student. Different students may share the same name. We risk updating the wrong student if we use NAME in the criterion.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
老师叫“陈同学出来！”可能三个姓陈的都站起来；叫学号就只有一人。SQL 也一样。

📏 规则

  • 改某一条记录，WHERE 用主键（或其他唯一栏位）：WHERE SID = '03517'。
  • 姓名会重复，WHERE NAME = 'Ben' 可能改错人。
  • 若题目针对一组（全部 1B），就用该组栏位。

📝 考试写法
SID is an identity number, which is supposed to be unique for each student. Different students may share the same name. We risk updating the wrong student if we use NAME in the criterion.

ex.q: Two students are named Ben (03517 in 1A, 03530 in 1C). Change 1A Ben's CNO to 10.
ex.a: UPDATE STUDENT SET CNO = 10 WHERE SID = '03517'
ex.az: 用 SID 指定。

ex.q: Move every 1C student to room 204 (field ROOM). Which criterion?
ex.a: A group task → WHERE CLASS = '1C' is correct here.
ex.az: 整组 → WHERE CLASS='1C'。

ex.q: Common mistake: UPDATE STUDENT SET CNO = 10 WHERE NAME = 'Ben' with two Bens.
ex.a: Both Bens get CNO 10 (code box shows 2 rows changed). Use the unique SID.
ex.az: 两个 Ben 都被改（2 行）。要用 SID。

code.out:
SID    NAME  CLASS  CNO
-----  ----  -----  ---
03517  Ben   1A     10 
03530  Ben   1C     10
code.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(16), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT);
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','1A',1),('03496','Clem','1B',15),('03505','Eva','1B',28),('03506','Gabe','1C',NULL),('03510','Finn','1B',7),('03513','Dio','1C',13),('03517','Ben','1A',9);

cards.t: Danger: UPDATE or DELETE without WHERE
cards.tz: 危险：UPDATE / DELETE 没有 WHERE
cards.en:
💡 The idea
Forgetting WHERE is like telling the whole school 'your name is now Bob'. SQL obeys: every record changes.

📏 The rule

  • UPDATE STUDENT SET NAME = 'Bob' → every name becomes Bob.
  • DELETE FROM STUDENT → every record gone (table stays, empty).
  • Safety habit: run SELECT * FROM t WHERE … with the same condition first, check the rows, then UPDATE/DELETE.

📝 Exam wording
UPDATE usually comes with a WHERE clause, otherwise it will update the whole table. Using DELETE without a WHERE clause simply deletes all records from the table.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
忘记 WHERE 就像对全校说“你们全部改名叫 Bob”。SQL 照做：每条记录都改。

📏 规则

  • UPDATE STUDENT SET NAME = 'Bob' → 全部变 Bob。
  • DELETE FROM STUDENT → 全部记录消失（表仍在，是空的）。
  • 好习惯：先用同一条件 SELECT 看看影响哪些行，再 UPDATE/DELETE。

📝 考试写法
UPDATE usually comes with a WHERE clause, otherwise it will update the whole table. Using DELETE without a WHERE clause simply deletes all records from the table.

ex.q: How many records change after UPDATE STUDENT SET NAME = 'Bob' on the 7-student table?
ex.a: All 7.
ex.az: 全部 7 条。

ex.q: Before deleting class 1C, what safe check do you run?
ex.a: SELECT * FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS = '1C' → Gabe, Dio. If correct, then DELETE FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS = '1C'.
ex.az: 先 SELECT 同一条件，确认 Gabe、Dio，再 DELETE。

ex.q: Common mistake: 'DELETE FROM STUDENT also removes the table.'
ex.a: No: the table structure stays, it is just empty. Removing the table needs DROP TABLE.
ex.az: 不会删表，只是清空。删表要 DROP TABLE。

code.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(16), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT);
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','1A',1),('03496','Clem','1B',15),('03505','Eva','1B',28),('03506','Gabe','1C',NULL),('03510','Finn','1B',7),('03513','Dio','1C',13),('03517','Ben','1A',9);

demo.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(16), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT);
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','1A',1),('03496','Clem','1B',15),('03505','Eva','1B',28),('03506','Gabe','1C',NULL),('03510','Finn','1B',7),('03513','Dio','1C',13),('03517','Ben','1A',9);
demo.query: UPDATE STUDENT SET NAME = 'Bob'; SELECT * FROM STUDENT
demo.note: No WHERE, so the whole NAME column becomes Bob.

cards.en:
💡 The idea
DELETE tears whole pages (records) out of the register. It never rubs out just one box.

📏 The rule
DELETE FROM table WHERE condition

  • Removes whole records that match.
  • No field list (DELETE NAME FROM is wrong).
  • To clear one value use UPDATE … SET f = NULL.
  • May be blocked by a FOREIGN KEY (1.6).

📝 Exam wording
DELETE FROM removes records that match the criterion.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
DELETE 是把整页（整条记录）撕走，从不只擦掉一格。

📏 规则
DELETE FROM 表 WHERE 条件

  • 删除符合条件的整条记录。
  • 不写栏位（DELETE NAME FROM 是错的）。
  • 清空一个值用 UPDATE … SET f = NULL。
  • 可能被 FOREIGN KEY 阻止（1.6）。

📝 考试写法
DELETE FROM removes records that match the criterion.

ex.q: Delete all class 1B students. Who remains?
ex.a: DELETE FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS = '1B' → Ada, Gabe, Dio, Ben remain.
ex.az: 剩 Ada、Gabe、Dio、Ben。

ex.q: Clear Dio's class number only.
ex.a: Not DELETE. UPDATE STUDENT SET CNO = NULL WHERE SID = '03513'
ex.az: 用 UPDATE 设 NULL。

ex.q: Common mistake: DELETE CNO FROM STUDENT WHERE SID = '03513'
ex.a: Syntax error: DELETE removes records, not fields. Use UPDATE … SET CNO = NULL.
ex.az: 语法错：DELETE 删记录不删栏位。

code.out:
NAME  CLASS
----  -----
Ada   1A   
Gabe  1C   
Dio   1C   
Ben   1A
code.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(16), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT);
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','1A',1),('03496','Clem','1B',15),('03505','Eva','1B',28),('03506','Gabe','1C',NULL),('03510','Finn','1B',7),('03513','Dio','1C',13),('03517','Ben','1A',9);

demo.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(16), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT);
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','1A',1),('03496','Clem','1B',15),('03505','Eva','1B',28),('03506','Gabe','1C',NULL),('03510','Finn','1B',7),('03513','Dio','1C',13),('03517','Ben','1A',9);
demo.query: DELETE FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS = '1B'; SELECT * FROM STUDENT
demo.note: Clem, Eva and Finn (class 1B) disappear as whole rows.

cards.en:
💡 The idea
A backup is a photo of your work before you take a risk. If you mess up, you go back to the photo.

📏 The rule

  • One careless statement can wipe or change a table: UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE, wrong criterion, DROP on the wrong table, MODIFY trimming zeros.
  • A backup is a copy kept elsewhere; restoring it rolls back the database to that moment.
  • Changes made after the backup are lost on restore, so back up regularly.

📝 Exam wording
Since one careless mistake is capable of wiping out or drastically changing a table, it is important to make a backup from time to time so that we may roll back the database to its previous state.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
备份就是冒险前替作品拍照。出错了就回到那张照片。

📏 规则

  • 一句粗心的语句可清空或大改一个表：没有 WHERE、条件错、DROP 错表、MODIFY 删前导零。
  • 备份是放在别处的副本；还原就把数据库回滚（roll back）到那一刻。
  • 备份后的改动在还原时会丢失，所以要定期备份。

📝 考试写法
Since one careless mistake is capable of wiping out or drastically changing a table, it is important to make a backup from time to time so that we may roll back the database to its previous state.

ex.q: Give two careless mistakes that make a backup necessary.
ex.a:
1. DELETE without WHERE deletes all records.
2. ALTER TABLE … MODIFY SID INT trims leading zeros.
ex.az: 没有 WHERE 的 DELETE；MODIFY 删前导零。

ex.q: Backup at 9:00, 3 new records added at 10:00, all records deleted by mistake at 11:00. Restore: what is lost?
ex.a: The database returns to 9:00, so the 3 records added at 10:00 are lost.

ex.q: Common mistake: keeping the only backup on the same disk as the database.
ex.a: If the disk fails, both are lost. Keep backups in another place (another drive / cloud).
ex.az: 同一磁碟坏了就一起没了。要放在别处。

frames.en: STUDENT has 7 records.
Copy the database to another place.
DELETE FROM STUDENT runs without WHERE: 0 records left.
frames.zh: 没有 WHERE 的 DELETE：剩 0 条。

frames.en: Restore from the backup: 7 records are back.
frames.zh: 从备份还原：7 条回来了。

cards.en:
💡 The idea
DELETE FROM empties the drawer. DROP TABLE throws away the whole drawer with everything inside.

📏 The rule
DELETE FROM STUDENTDROP TABLE STUDENT
Recordsremoved (all, or those matching WHERE)all removed
Table structurekept, can insert againremoved, must CREATE again
WHERE?yesno

📝 Exam wording
DROP TABLE deletes the whole table from the database. Once a table is deleted, all its records, if any, will be deleted as well.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
DELETE FROM 是清空抽屉；DROP TABLE 是连抽屉一起丢掉。

📏 规则
DELETE FROMDROP TABLE
记录删除（全部或合条件的）全部删除
表结构保留，可再插入删除，要重新 CREATE
可用 WHERE？可以不可

📝 考试写法
DROP TABLE deletes the whole table from the database. Once a table is deleted, all its records, if any, will be deleted as well.

ex.q: You want to clear all old records but keep using the table. Which statement?
ex.a: DELETE FROM STUDENT: structure kept.
ex.az: DELETE FROM，结构保留。

ex.q: After DROP TABLE STUDENT, what happens to SELECT * FROM STUDENT?
ex.a: Error: no such table. It must be created again.
ex.az: 出错：没有此表。

ex.q: Common mistake: DROP TABLE STUDENT WHERE CLASS = '1B'
ex.a: DROP has no WHERE; it always removes the whole table. Use DELETE FROM … WHERE.
ex.az: DROP 没有 WHERE。用 DELETE … WHERE。

notes.t: Now an error: the table is gone.

code.out:
after_delete
------------
0
Error: no such table: STUDENT

cards.en:
💡 The idea
If DROP TABLE throws away a drawer, DROP DATABASE throws away the whole cupboard with all its drawers.

📏 The rule
DROP DATABASE SCHOOLE

  • Removes the database and all its tables and records.
  • Scale of destruction: DELETE (records) → DROP TABLE (one table) → DROP DATABASE (all tables).
  • Make sure a backup exists first.

📝 Exam wording
Once a database is deleted, all its tables, if any, will be deleted as well.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
DROP TABLE 丢一个抽屉；DROP DATABASE 是连整个柜和所有抽屉一起丢。

📏 规则
DROP DATABASE SCHOOLE

  • 删除数据库和所有表及记录。
  • 破坏程度：DELETE（记录）→ DROP TABLE（一个表）→ DROP DATABASE（全部表）。
  • 执行前确保有备份。

📝 考试写法
Once a database is deleted, all its tables, if any, will be deleted as well.

ex.q: After DROP DATABASE SCHOOLE; what does SHOW DATABASES show?
ex.a: SCHOOLA, SCHOOLB, SCHOOLC, SCHOOLD (SCHOOLE is gone).
ex.az: SCHOOLE 消失。

ex.q: Rank by how much is removed: DROP TABLE, DELETE FROM … WHERE, DROP DATABASE.
ex.a: DELETE … WHERE (some records) < DROP TABLE (one table) < DROP DATABASE (all tables).
ex.az: DELETE … WHERE < DROP TABLE < DROP DATABASE。

ex.q: Common mistake: 'DROP DATABASE keeps the tables so we can USE them later.'
ex.a: No: every table and record inside is deleted. Only a backup can bring them back.
ex.az: 错：所有表和记录都删除，只能靠备份。

code.src:
DROP DATABASE SCHOOLE;
SHOW DATABASES;

notes.t: MySQL: delete the database SCHOOLE and all its tables.
notes.tz: MySQL：删除 SCHOOLE 及其所有表。

code.out:
Query OK, 3 rows affected
Database
SCHOOLA
SCHOOLB
SCHOOLC
SCHOOLD

cards.en:
💡 The idea
This example joins 1.3 to 1.5: choose types, create, insert, update. Treat it as a 4-step routine.

📏 The rule
PRODUCT: PID (2 letters + 4 digits), PNAME (max 80), STOCK, PRICE, EXPIRY (if any).

  1. Types: PID letters → CHAR(6); STOCK whole → INT; PRICE decimals → FLOAT; EXPIRY → DATE.
  2. CREATE TABLE with those types.
  3. INSERT Smart Candy, $14.5, 24/11/2042, 138 in stock, SN2359 → convert date, drop $.
  4. Sold out BA1100 → UPDATE STOCK = 0 WHERE PID = 'BA1100'.

📝 Exam wording
Give reasons: 'PID contains letters, so character type.' 'STOCK cannot have a decimal part, so integer.' 'PRICE usually has a decimal part, so real number.'
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
这例子串连 1.3 至 1.5：选类型、建表、插入、更新。当作四步流程。

📏 规则
PRODUCT：PID（2 字母+4 数字）、PNAME（最长 80）、STOCK、PRICE、EXPIRY（如有）。

  1. 类型：PID 有字母 → CHAR(6)；STOCK 整数 → INT；PRICE 有小数 → FLOAT；EXPIRY → DATE。
  2. 按类型 CREATE TABLE。
  3. 插入 Smart Candy，$14.5，24/11/2042，库存 138，SN2359 → 转日期、去 $。
  4. BA1100 售罄 → UPDATE STOCK = 0。

📝 考试写法
要写理由：'PID contains letters, so character type.' 'STOCK cannot have a decimal part, so integer.' 'PRICE usually has a decimal part, so real number.'

ex.q: Write the INSERT for Smart Candy (c).
ex.a:
1. Table order: PID, PNAME, STOCK, PRICE, EXPIRY.
2. $14.5 → 14.5; 24/11/2042 → '2042-11-24'.
INSERT INTO PRODUCT VALUES ('SN2359', 'Smart Candy', 138, 14.5, '2042-11-24')
ex.az: 依表次序，去 $，日期改格式。

ex.q: (d) BA1100 is sold out.
ex.a: UPDATE PRODUCT SET STOCK = 0 WHERE PID = 'BA1100'
ex.az: UPDATE STOCK=0 WHERE PID='BA1100'。

ex.q: Common mistake: VALUES ('SN2359', 'Smart Candy', 14.5, 138, '2042-11-24')
ex.a: PRICE and STOCK swapped: stock becomes 14.5 and price 138. Follow table order STOCK then PRICE.
ex.az: STOCK 与 PRICE 次序调转了。

code.setup: CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (PID CHAR(6), PNAME VARCHAR(80), STOCK INT, PRICE FLOAT, EXPIRY DATE); INSERT INTO PRODUCT VALUES ('BA1100','Banana Chips',25,9.9,'2041-05-01'),('CO0420','Cola',300,7.5,'2040-12-31');

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (PID CHAR(6), PNAME VARCHAR(80), STOCK INT, PRICE FLOAT, EXPIRY DATE); INSERT INTO PRODUCT VALUES ('BA1100','Banana Chips',25,9.9,'2041-05-01'),('CO0420','Cola',300,7.5,'2040-12-31');
demo.query: INSERT INTO PRODUCT VALUES ('SN2359', 'Smart Candy', 138, 14.5, '2042-11-24'); UPDATE PRODUCT SET STOCK = 0 WHERE PID = 'BA1100'; SELECT * FROM PRODUCT
demo.note: A new row appears and BA1100's stock becomes 0.

cards.en:
💡 The idea
A constraint is a rule the DBMS guards for you, like a security guard checking every visitor. The most important rule is the primary key: every record needs its own ID card, never shared, never blank.

📏 The rule

  • Constraints are checked on every INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.
  • Primary key: a field (or fields) whose value is unique and not NULL for every record.
  • At most one primary key per table (it may be made of several fields).
  • Typical: SID, HKID, PID.

📝 Exam wording
To maintain data integrity and validate data input, we should set constraints for a table. Primary key is a field or a combination of fields that store unique data for every record. The value stored in the primary key field cannot be empty, i.e. NULL.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
约束（constraint）是 DBMS 替你看守的规则，像保安检查每位访客。最重要的是主键（primary key）：每条记录都有自己的身份证，不可共用，不可空白。

📏 规则

  • 每次 INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE 都会检查约束。
  • 主键：每条记录的值唯一且非 NULL。
  • 每表最多一个主键（可由多栏组成）。
  • 常见：SID、HKID、PID。

📝 考试写法
To maintain data integrity and validate data input, we should set constraints for a table. Primary key is a field or a combination of fields that store unique data for every record. The value stored in the primary key field cannot be empty, i.e. NULL.

ex.q: State the two properties of a primary key.
ex.a:
1. Unique: no two records share the value.
2. Not NULL: every record has a value.
ex.az: 唯一、非 NULL。

ex.q: Why should a table always have a primary key?
ex.a: To identify a record from all other records, e.g. so UPDATE/DELETE can target exactly one student.
ex.az: 用来识别每一条记录。

ex.q: Common mistake: 'A table can have two primary keys, SID and HKID.'
ex.a: Only one primary key per table. The other unique field can be given UNIQUE instead.
ex.az: 每表只有一个主键；另一栏可设 UNIQUE。

code.out:
Error: UNIQUE constraint failed: STUDENT.SID
SID    NAME  CLASS  CNO
-----  ----  -----  ---
03493  Ada   1A     1

cards.en:
💡 The idea
A good ID is like a fingerprint: everyone has one, no two are the same, and it never changes.

📏 The rule
Test each candidate with three questions:

  1. Possible to have duplications?
  2. Available for everyone?
  3. Possible to change?
FieldDup?Everyone?Changes?
HKIDNoYesNo
ENAMEYesYesYes
DOBYesYesNo
BANKACNoNoYes
EMAILNoNoYes
Only HKID passes all three.

📝 Exam wording
HKID is chosen as the primary key because it is unique for each citizen, available for every citizen, and does not change.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
好的 ID 像指纹：人人都有、各不相同、永不改变。

📏 规则
每个候选栏位问三条：

  1. 会重复吗？
  2. 人人都有吗？
  3. 会改变吗？
栏位重复？人人有？会变？
HKID否是否
ENAME是是是
DOB是是否
BANKAC否否是
EMAIL否否是
只有 HKID 全部通过。

📝 考试写法
HKID is chosen as the primary key because it is unique for each citizen, available for every citizen, and does not change.

ex.q: Why is EMAIL not a good primary key for HKCITIZEN?
ex.a: Some citizens have no email → the key would be NULL, which a primary key forbids. Emails can also change.
ex.az: 有人没有电邮 → NULL；电邮也会改。

ex.q: Pick a primary key for LOCKER(LNO, FLOOR, OWNER_SID, COLOUR) where every locker has a unique number.
ex.a: LNO: unique, every locker has one, never changes. OWNER_SID fails (empty lockers have no owner).
ex.az: LNO。OWNER_SID 不行（空柜无主人）。

ex.q: Common mistake: choosing DOB because 'it never changes'.
ex.a: Passing one test is not enough. Many people share a birthday → duplicates.
ex.az: 只过一关不够：生日会重复。

frames.en: Duplicates? Yes (two people called Chan Tai Man). ✗
Duplicates? Yes, many share a birthday. ✗
Unique, but not everyone has a bank account → NULL. ✗
Unique ✓ Everyone has one ✓ Never changes ✓ → primary key.
frames.zh: 唯一 ✓ 人人有 ✓ 不变 ✓ → 主键

cards.en:
💡 The idea
Once you mark a field as PRIMARY KEY, the DBMS blocks any attempt (insert or update) to create a duplicate or a blank in it.

📏 The rule
SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY inside CREATE TABLE.

  • Duplicate on insert → error; in a multi-row INSERT no record is inserted.
  • Missing SID (NULL) → error.
  • UPDATE that creates a duplicate → error.
  • In diagrams you may underline the key.

📝 Exam wording
Constraint PRIMARY KEY prevents a field from storing duplicated values or NULL by any means, including insertion and updating.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
把栏位设为 PRIMARY KEY 后，DBMS 会阻止任何（插入或更新）造成重复或空白的操作。

📏 规则
在 CREATE TABLE 内写 SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY。

  • 插入重复 → 出错；多行 INSERT 中一条都不会插入。
  • 缺 SID（NULL）→ 出错。
  • UPDATE 造成重复 → 出错。
  • 图中可在主键下加底线。

📝 考试写法
Constraint PRIMARY KEY prevents a field from storing duplicated values or NULL by any means, including insertion and updating.

ex.q: STUDENT has 03506 Gabe and 03513 Dio. What happens: UPDATE STUDENT SET SID = '03506' WHERE NAME = 'Dio'?
ex.a: It would make two 03506 → error, nothing changes.
ex.az: 会造成重复 → 出错。

ex.q: Insert ('03493','Ada'…), ('03496','Clem'…), ('03493','Eva'…) in one statement. How many are stored?
ex.a: 0: 03493 is duplicated, so the whole statement fails.
ex.az: 0 条：整句失败。

ex.q: Common mistake (SQLite only): INSERT INTO STUDENT (NAME) VALUES ('Gabe') succeeding with a CHAR primary key.
ex.a: SQLite has an old quirk that lets NULL into non-INTEGER primary keys unless NOT NULL is added. MySQL and DSE follow the rule: primary key cannot be NULL. In SQLite write SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL.
ex.az: SQLite 旧怪癖容许 NULL；MySQL/DSE：主键不可 NULL。SQLite 要加 NOT NULL。

notes.t: SID is the primary key (NOT NULL added for SQLite).
notes.tz: SID 为主键（SQLite 加 NOT NULL）。

code.out:
Error: UNIQUE constraint failed: STUDENT.SID
Error: NOT NULL constraint failed: STUDENT.SID
SID    NAME
-----  ----
03506  Gabe
03513  Dio

cards.en:
💡 The idea
No single field is unique, but a pair is. Many students are in class 1C, and many are number 15, but only one student is '1C number 15'.

📏 The rule
PRIMARY KEY(CLASS, CNO) on its own line after the fields.

  • Each field alone may repeat.
  • The combination must be unique (and not NULL).
  • Other examples: PCODE + GCODE (games), FLOOR + RNUM (hotel rooms).

📝 Exam wording
We may set a combination of fields as the primary key of the table. Such a primary key is called a composite key. Every combination of the fields must be unique.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
没有单一栏位是唯一的，但两栏组合是。很多学生在 1C，很多学生是 15 号，但“1C 15 号”只有一人。

📏 规则
在栏位后另起一行写 PRIMARY KEY(CLASS, CNO)。

  • 单一栏位可重复。
  • 组合必须唯一（且非 NULL）。
  • 例：PCODE+GCODE（游戏）、FLOOR+RNUM（酒店房间）。

📝 考试写法
We may set a combination of fields as the primary key of the table. Such a primary key is called a composite key. Every combination of the fields must be unique.

ex.q: With PRIMARY KEY(CLASS, CNO): can (1B,15) and (1C,15) both exist?
ex.a: Yes: the combinations differ.
ex.az: 可以，组合不同。

ex.q: Hotel ROOM(FLOOR, RNUM, TYPE): rooms 12-01 and 15-01 exist. Choose the key.
ex.a: RNUM repeats on every floor; FLOOR repeats too. → composite PRIMARY KEY(FLOOR, RNUM).
ex.az: PRIMARY KEY(FLOOR, RNUM)。

ex.q: Common mistake: CLASS CHAR(2) PRIMARY KEY, CNO INT PRIMARY KEY
ex.a: That tries to create two primary keys → error. A composite key is ONE key on a separate line: PRIMARY KEY(CLASS, CNO).
ex.az: 这是两个主键 → 出错。复合键要另起一行。

code.out:
Error: UNIQUE constraint failed: STUDENT.CLASS, STUDENT.CNO
NAME  CLASS  CNO
----  -----  ---
Clem  1B     15 
Dio   1C     15

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE STUDENT (NAME VARCHAR(40), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT, PRIMARY KEY(CLASS, CNO)); INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('Clem','1B',15),('Dio','1C',15),('Eva','1B',28);
demo.query: SELECT * FROM STUDENT ORDER BY CNO
demo.note: CLASS repeats and CNO repeats, but each (CLASS, CNO) pair is different.

cards.t: Foreign key: host table and parent table
cards.tz: 外键：host table 与 parent table
cards.en:
💡 The idea
A student's class must be a real class. A foreign key is a link that says 'this value must exist in that other table', like a seat ticket that must match a real seat.

📏 The rule

  • A foreign key in table X (host) is always the primary key of table Y (parent).
  • STUDENT.CLASS (host) → CLASSLIST.CLASSNAME (parent).
  • Names may differ, but data types should match.
  • One parent record (1A) can be referred to by many host records.

📝 Exam wording
Foreign keys are used to show the relationship between records in two tables. A foreign key in a table X is always the primary key of another table Y. Table X is the host table, while table Y is the parent table.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
学生的班别必须是真实存在的班。外键（foreign key）是一条连结，说明“这个值必须在另一表中存在”，像戏票必须对应真实座位。

📏 规则

  • 表 X（host）的外键一定是表 Y（parent）的主键。
  • STUDENT.CLASS（host）→ CLASSLIST.CLASSNAME（parent）。
  • 名称可不同，数据类型要一致。
  • 一条 parent 记录（1A）可被多条 host 记录引用。

📝 考试写法
Foreign keys are used to show the relationship between records in two tables. A foreign key in a table X is always the primary key of another table Y. Table X is the host table, while table Y is the parent table.

ex.q: BORROW(BID, SID, BDATE) records loans; STUDENT(SID…) and BOOK(BID…) exist. Name the foreign keys.
ex.a: BORROW.SID → STUDENT(SID); BORROW.BID → BOOK(BID). BORROW is the host table.
ex.az: BORROW.SID→STUDENT；BORROW.BID→BOOK。

ex.q: Why make STUDENT.CLASS a foreign key?
ex.a: So that no student belongs to a non-existing class.
ex.az: 防止学生属于不存在的班。

ex.q: Common mistake: 'CLASSLIST is the host table because it holds the classes.'
ex.a: The host is the table that contains the foreign key (STUDENT). The table being referred to (CLASSLIST) is the parent.
ex.az: 含外键的是 host（STUDENT）；被引用的是 parent（CLASSLIST）。

frames.en: CLASSLIST has classes 1A–1D; CLASSNAME is its primary key.
STUDENT.CLASS stores a class name for each student.
frames.zh: STUDENT.CLASS 存每位学生的班别。

frames.en: FOREIGN KEY: every STUDENT.CLASS must exist in CLASSLIST.CLASSNAME.
frames.zh: 外键：STUDENT.CLASS 必须在 CLASSLIST 中存在。

cards.en:
💡 The idea
You write the link inside the host table's CREATE TABLE, pointing at the parent's primary key.

📏 The rule
FOREIGN KEY (host_field) REFERENCES parent_table(parent_pk)

  • Own line after the fields.
  • Create the parent first.
  • A table may have several FOREIGN KEY lines.
  • SQLite enforces it only after PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; (the practice site turns it on).

📝 Exam wording
FOREIGN KEY (CLASS) REFERENCES CLASSLIST(CLASSNAME)
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
在 host 表的 CREATE TABLE 内写连结，指向 parent 的主键。

📏 规则
FOREIGN KEY (host 栏位) REFERENCES parent 表(parent 主键)

  • 在栏位之后另起一行。
  • 先建 parent。
  • 一个表可有多条 FOREIGN KEY。
  • SQLite 要 PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; 才执行（练习网站已开启）。

📝 考试写法
FOREIGN KEY (CLASS) REFERENCES CLASSLIST(CLASSNAME)

ex.q: Write CREATE TABLE BORROW(BID CHAR(6), SID CHAR(5), BDATE DATE) with both foreign keys.
ex.a: CREATE TABLE BORROW (BID CHAR(6), SID CHAR(5), BDATE DATE, FOREIGN KEY (BID) REFERENCES BOOK(BID), FOREIGN KEY (SID) REFERENCES STUDENT(SID))
ex.az: 两条 FOREIGN KEY 各占一行。

ex.q: Read aloud: FOREIGN KEY (HOUSE) REFERENCES HOUSELIST(HOUSE).
ex.a: 'Every HOUSE value in this table must exist in the HOUSE field of HOUSELIST.'
ex.az: 这表的 HOUSE 必须在 HOUSELIST.HOUSE 中存在。

ex.q: Common mistake: FOREIGN KEY CLASS REFERENCES CLASSLIST
ex.a: Brackets are required around the host field, and the parent field should be named: FOREIGN KEY (CLASS) REFERENCES CLASSLIST(CLASSNAME).
ex.az: 要括号并写 parent 栏位。

notes.t: Field that will be the foreign key (same type as CLASSNAME).
notes.tz: 将成为外键（类型同 CLASSNAME）。

notes.t: Link CLASS to the parent's primary key.
SQLite: list the foreign keys of STUDENT.

code.out:
from   table      to       
-----  ---------  ---------
CLASS  CLASSLIST  CLASSNAME

cards.tz: FOREIGN KEY 的效果（参照完整性）
cards.en:
💡 The idea
The link works both ways. A student can't join a class that doesn't exist, and a class can't be closed or renamed while students are still in it.

📏 The rule

  • Host side: INSERT or UPDATE STUDENT with CLASS '1E' (not in CLASSLIST) → error.
  • Parent side: DELETE or rename class 1A while a student refers to it → error.
  • A parent record with no host records (1D) can be deleted.
  • To remove a used parent record, first delete/change the host records.

📝 Exam wording
Constraint FOREIGN KEY prevents a field from storing a value that does not exist in the corresponding field of the parent table by any means, including insertion, update and deletion.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
连结是双向的：学生不能加入不存在的班；班里还有学生时，班也不能删除或改名。

📏 规则

  • Host 方：INSERT/UPDATE 学生的 CLASS 为 '1E'（不在 CLASSLIST）→ 出错。
  • Parent 方：有学生引用 1A 时，删除或改名 1A → 出错。
  • 没被引用的（1D）可以删除。
  • 要删除被引用的 parent 记录，先删/改 host 记录。

📝 考试写法
Constraint FOREIGN KEY prevents a field from storing a value that does not exist in the corresponding field of the parent table by any means, including insertion, update and deletion.

ex.q: Ada is in 1A. Which succeed? (i) DELETE FROM CLASSLIST WHERE CLASSNAME='1D' (ii) DELETE … WHERE CLASSNAME='1A'
ex.a:
(i) succeeds: no student in 1D.
(ii) fails: Ada refers to 1A.
ex.az: (i) 成功；(ii) 失败。

ex.q: How can class 1A be deleted?
ex.a:
1. Move or delete its students: e.g. UPDATE STUDENT SET CLASS='1B' WHERE CLASS='1A'.
2. Then DELETE FROM CLASSLIST WHERE CLASSNAME='1A'.
ex.az: 先处理学生，再删班。

ex.q: Common mistake: 'Foreign keys only check INSERT.'
ex.a: They also check UPDATE (host and parent) and DELETE (parent). See code box: 3 different statements are blocked.
ex.az: 也检查 UPDATE 和 DELETE。

notes.t: Host insert: 1E does not exist → error.
notes.tz: Host 插入：1E 不存在 → 错。

notes.t: Parent delete: Ada still uses 1A → error.
notes.tz: Parent 删除：Ada 仍用 1A → 错。

code.out:
Error: FOREIGN KEY constraint failed
Error: FOREIGN KEY constraint failed
Error: FOREIGN KEY constraint failed
CLASSNAME
---------
1A       
1B       
1C
code.setup: CREATE TABLE CLASSLIST (CLASSNAME CHAR(2) PRIMARY KEY, TEACHER VARCHAR(20), LOCATION CHAR(3)); INSERT INTO CLASSLIST VALUES ('1A','Ms Ho','101'),('1B','Mr Lam','102'),('1C','Ms Yu','103'),('1D','Mr Ip','104');CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR(40), CLASS CHAR(2), FOREIGN KEY (CLASS) REFERENCES CLASSLIST(CLASSNAME));

frames.en: STUDENT asks for class 1E. CLASSLIST has no 1E → rejected.
frames.zh: 要求 1E，CLASSLIST 没有 → 拒绝。

frames.en: Parent wants to delete 1A but Ada refers to it → rejected.
frames.zh: 删 1A，但 Ada 引用 → 拒绝。

frames.en: No student in 1D → allowed.

cards.en:
💡 The idea
Besides IDs, you can add more guard rules: 'name must be filled', 'no two same class numbers', 'score starts at 0', 'score can't be negative'.

📏 The rule
KeywordEffect
NOT NULLvalue cannot be NULL
UNIQUEvalue must be unique
DEFAULT 0value is 0 if not given
CHECK (SCORE >= 0)condition must be TRUE for every record
FOREIGN KEYvalue must exist in the parent

📝 Exam wording
Constraints are useful for data validation and shorten our time for data management.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
除了 ID，还可加更多看守规则：“姓名必填”、“学号不可重复”、“分数默认 0”、“分数不可负”。

📏 规则
关键字效果
NOT NULL不可 NULL
UNIQUE值必须唯一
DEFAULT 0没给值时为 0
CHECK (SCORE >= 0)每条记录条件必须为 TRUE
FOREIGN KEY值必须在 parent 中

📝 考试写法
Constraints are useful for data validation and shorten our time for data management.

ex.q: Insert ('03501','Amy',3,'R') without SCORE. What is SCORE?
ex.a: DEFAULT gives 0.
ex.az: DEFAULT → 0。

ex.q: Which constraint rejects ('03502','Bo',4,'G',-5)?
ex.a: CHECK (SCORE >= 0): −5 makes the condition FALSE.
ex.az: CHECK。

ex.q: Common mistake: thinking DEFAULT stops someone typing NULL on purpose.
ex.a: DEFAULT only fills a value when the field is not given. Explicit NULL is still stored unless the field is also NOT NULL.
ex.az: DEFAULT 只在没给值时生效；明确写 NULL 仍会存入，除非也有 NOT NULL。

notes.t: FOREIGN KEY: house Y not in HOUSELIST.

Error: NOT NULL constraint failed: STUDENT1A.NAME
Error: UNIQUE constraint failed: STUDENT1A.CNO
Error: FOREIGN KEY constraint failed
SID    NAME  CNO  HOUSE  SCORE
-----  ----  ---  -----  -----
03501  Amy   3    R      0
code.setup: CREATE TABLE HOUSELIST (HOUSE CHAR(1) PRIMARY KEY, HNAME VARCHAR(10)); INSERT INTO HOUSELIST VALUES ('R','Red'),('G','Green');

cards.t: PRIMARY KEY vs UNIQUE vs NOT NULL; combining constraints
cards.tz: PRIMARY KEY、UNIQUE、NOT NULL 比较与组合
cards.en:
💡 The idea
Think of three rules at a club. UNIQUE: no two members share a locker (but a member may have none). NOT NULL: everyone must write a name. PRIMARY KEY: everyone has a membership number, no repeats, no blanks.

📏 The rule
Duplicates?NULL?Per table
PRIMARY KEYNoNoone
UNIQUENoYesmany
NOT NULLYesNomany
A field may have several keywords (NAME VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TBA'), and a constraint may cover several fields (UNIQUE(CLASS, CNO)).

📝 Exam wording
PRIMARY KEY ≈ UNIQUE + NOT NULL, and it is the field used to identify records. We may apply more than one keyword to a field, as well as apply a keyword to more than one field.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
想像会所三条规则：UNIQUE——储物柜不可两人共用（但可以没有）；NOT NULL——人人必须写名字；PRIMARY KEY——人人有会员号，不重复、不空白。

📏 规则
可重复？可 NULL？每表
PRIMARY KEY否否一个
UNIQUE否可多个
NOT NULL可否多个
一栏可有多个关键字（NAME VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TBA'），一个约束可涵盖多栏（UNIQUE(CLASS, CNO)）。

📝 考试写法
PRIMARY KEY ≈ UNIQUE + NOT NULL，并用来识别记录。We may apply more than one keyword to a field, as well as apply a keyword to more than one field.

ex.q: SHOP(SID, SNAME, PHONE): SID is the ID, shop names must not repeat, phone must be filled. Write the field definitions.
ex.a: SID CHAR(4) PRIMARY KEY, SNAME VARCHAR(40) UNIQUE, PHONE CHAR(8) NOT NULL
ex.az: SID 主键、SNAME UNIQUE、PHONE NOT NULL。

ex.q: With UNIQUE(CLASS, CNO), can two students both have CNO NULL in class 1C?
ex.a: Yes: UNIQUE allows NULL, and NULLs are not considered equal to each other.
ex.az: 可以：UNIQUE 容许 NULL。

ex.q: Common mistake: using UNIQUE instead of PRIMARY KEY for the ID field 'because it is the same'.
ex.a: UNIQUE still allows NULL, and a foreign key should refer to the primary key. Use PRIMARY KEY for the identifying field.
ex.az: UNIQUE 仍容许 NULL；识别用的栏位要用 PRIMARY KEY。

notes.t: One keyword on two fields: the pair must be unique.

code.out:
Error: UNIQUE constraint failed: STUDENT.CLASS, STUDENT.CNO
SID    NAME  CLASS  CNO
-----  ----  -----  ---
03510  TBA   1C     4

cards.en:
💡 The idea
Like a ticket machine at a bank: each new customer gets the next number automatically. You don't need to think of a number.

📏 The rule

  • NID INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT (MySQL).
  • Leave NID out of INSERT; it is filled 1, 2, 3, …
  • Good when the ID only identifies records and is not shown to users (e.g. notices on a web page).
  • SQLite: NID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (optionally AUTOINCREMENT, no underscore).

📝 Exam wording
AUTO_INCREMENT is a feature that can be applied to a primary key field. The value will be automatically assigned, starting from 1.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
像银行的筹号机：每位新客人自动拿下一个号码，不用自己想。

📏 规则

  • MySQL：NID INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT。
  • INSERT 时不写 NID，会自动填 1、2、3…
  • 适合只用来识别、不显示给用户的 ID（如网页通告）。
  • SQLite：NID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY（可加 AUTOINCREMENT，没有底线）。

📝 考试写法
AUTO_INCREMENT is a feature that can be applied to a primary key field. The value will be automatically assigned, starting from 1.

ex.q: Two notices are inserted into an empty NOTICE table. What NIDs do they get?
ex.a: 1 and 2.

ex.q: Notice 2 is deleted, then a new one inserted. What NID (MySQL)?
ex.a: 3: AUTO_INCREMENT keeps counting and does not reuse 2.
ex.az: 3：不会重用 2。

ex.q: Common mistake: INSERT INTO NOTICE VALUES ('Zack', 'Good morning', '2026-06-02 20:26:26')
ex.a: Without a field list, a value for NID is expected too → error (3 values for 4 fields). List the fields: INSERT INTO NOTICE (AUTHOR, CONTENT, CREATETIME) VALUES (…).
ex.az: 没列栏位就要给 4 个值 → 出错。要列出栏位。

code.out:
NID  AUTHOR  CONTENT     
---  ------  ------------
1    Zack    Good morning
3    Zack    Hi

cards.en:
💡 The idea
If GID is just PCODE and GCODE glued together, then GID says nothing new. Storing it is like writing your full address and then also writing 'district' separately: extra work, and the two can disagree.

📏 The rule
GAME(PCODE, GCODE, GID, GNAME, GENREID, PRICE); GID = PCODE + GCODE.

  1. Primary key: GID, or composite PCODE + GCODE.
  2. Foreign keys: PCODE → PUBLISHER(CODE); GENREID → GENRE(ID).
  3. GID is redundant. PCODE is still needed as a foreign key, so drop GID and use PRIMARY KEY(PCODE, GCODE).

📝 Exam wording
A redundant field stores data that can be derived from other fields or found in another table. e.g. 'GID is redundant because it can be derived from PCODE and GCODE.'
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
若 GID 只是 PCODE 和 GCODE 拼起来，它就没有新资料。存它好像写了完整地址，又另写一次“地区”：多余，而且两者可能不一致。

📏 规则
GAME(PCODE, GCODE, GID, GNAME, GENREID, PRICE)；GID = PCODE + GCODE。

  1. 主键：GID，或复合键 PCODE+GCODE。
  2. 外键：PCODE → PUBLISHER(CODE)；GENREID → GENRE(ID)。
  3. GID 是冗余（redundant）的。PCODE 要做外键，所以删 GID，用 PRIMARY KEY(PCODE, GCODE)。

📝 考试写法
A redundant field stores data that can be derived from other fields or found in another table. 例：'GID is redundant because it can be derived from PCODE and GCODE.'

ex.q: Why must PCODE be kept rather than GID?
ex.a: PCODE is the foreign key to PUBLISHER; GID cannot be used as a foreign key to PUBLISHER.
ex.az: PCODE 是指向 PUBLISHER 的外键。

ex.q: SHOP(SID, SNAME, MID, MSEX) and MANAGER(MID, MNAME, MSEX). Which field in SHOP is redundant?
ex.a: MSEX: it can be found in MANAGER using MID.
ex.az: MSEX：可从 MANAGER 找到。

ex.q: Common mistake: 'Drop PCODE and GCODE and keep GID, since one field is simpler.'
ex.a: Then the link to PUBLISHER is lost (no foreign key field). Drop GID instead.
ex.az: 会失去与 PUBLISHER 的连结。应删 GID。

code.src:
CREATE TABLE GAME (
  PCODE CHAR(2) NOT NULL,
  GCODE CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
  GNAME VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  GENREID INT,
  PRICE FLOAT,
  PRIMARY KEY (PCODE, GCODE),
  FOREIGN KEY (PCODE) REFERENCES PUBLISHER(CODE),
  FOREIGN KEY (GENREID) REFERENCES GENRE(ID)
);
INSERT INTO GAME VALUES ('NT', '001', 'Star Hero', 1, 399.0), ('SE', '001', 'Block Mind', 2, 120.5);
SELECT PCODE || GCODE AS GID, GNAME FROM GAME

notes.tz: 删除 GID 后的设计。

notes.t: Publisher code; part of key and a foreign key.
notes.tz: 出版商代码：主键一部分及外键。

notes.t: Same GCODE 001 for different publishers: OK.
notes.tz: 不同出版商同 GCODE：可以。

notes.t: GID can be derived any time, so storing it is redundant.
notes.tz: GID 可随时推算，所以存它是冗余。

code.out:
GID    GNAME     
-----  ----------
NT001  Star Hero 
SE001  Block Mind
code.setup: CREATE TABLE PUBLISHER (CODE CHAR(2) PRIMARY KEY, PNAME VARCHAR(40)); CREATE TABLE GENRE (ID INT PRIMARY KEY, GNAME VARCHAR(20)); INSERT INTO PUBLISHER VALUES ('NT','Nintendo'),('SE','Square Enix'); INSERT INTO GENRE VALUES (1,'RPG'),(2,'Puzzle');

cards.en:
💡 The idea
ALTER TABLE is renovating a room without moving the furniture out. Renaming the table is changing the sign on the door: everything inside stays.

📏 The rule

  • MySQL: ALTER TABLE STUDNET RENAME STUDENT (RENAME TO also accepted).
  • SQLite: ALTER TABLE STUDNET RENAME TO STUDENT.
  • Records are unchanged.
  • Some alterations can lose data, so proceed with care.

📝 Exam wording
After creating a table, its structure can still be altered. Some of the alterations may result in data loss so we should proceed with caution.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
ALTER TABLE 像装修房间但不搬走家具。改表名只是换门牌，里面的东西不变。

📏 规则

  • MySQL：ALTER TABLE STUDNET RENAME STUDENT（也可写 RENAME TO）。
  • SQLite：ALTER TABLE STUDNET RENAME TO STUDENT。
  • 记录不变。
  • 有些修改会丢失数据，要小心。

📝 考试写法
After creating a table, its structure can still be altered. Some of the alterations may result in data loss so we should proceed with caution.

ex.q: The table was created as STUDNET by mistake. Fix it (MySQL).
ex.a: ALTER TABLE STUDNET RENAME STUDENT
ex.az: ALTER TABLE STUDNET RENAME STUDENT。

ex.q: Are the 7 records still there after renaming?
ex.a: Yes: only the name changes.
ex.az: 在：只改名称。

ex.q: Common mistake: RENAME TABLE STUDNET STUDENT without ALTER… or ALTER STUDNET RENAME STUDENT
ex.a: The word TABLE after ALTER is required: ALTER TABLE STUDNET RENAME STUDENT. (MySQL has a separate RENAME TABLE a TO b, but stick to the textbook form.)
ex.az: ALTER 后必须有 TABLE。

notes.t: The record is still there under the new name.

cards.en:
💡 The idea
Adding a column is like adding a new box to a form that people have already filled in. Old forms have that box empty, unless you print a default value in it.

📏 The rule
ALTER TABLE t ADD field type [constraints]

  • New field goes at the end.
  • Existing records get NULL, or the DEFAULT if one is given.
  • SQLite writes ADD COLUMN; MySQL accepts both.

📝 Exam wording
Beware that the newly added field contains no data if it does not have a default value.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
加一栏好像在已填好的表格上加新格：旧表格那格是空的，除非你印上默认值。

📏 规则
ALTER TABLE t ADD 栏位 类型 [约束]

  • 新栏放在最后。
  • 现有记录得到 NULL，或 DEFAULT 值。
  • SQLite 写 ADD COLUMN；MySQL 两种都可。

📝 考试写法
Beware that the newly added field contains no data if it does not have a default value.

ex.q: Add EMAIL VARCHAR(60) to STUDENT. What do the 7 existing students have in EMAIL?
ex.a: ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD EMAIL VARCHAR(60) → all NULL.
ex.az: 全部 NULL。

ex.q: Add HOUSE CHAR(1) with default 'R'. What do existing records get?
ex.a: ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD HOUSE CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'R' → every existing record gets 'R'.
ex.az: 全部 'R'。

ex.q: Common mistake: ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD EMAIL
ex.a: The data type is missing. Like CREATE TABLE, a new field needs a type: ADD EMAIL VARCHAR(60).
ex.az: 缺数据类型。

code.out:
NAME  EMAIL  HOUSE
----  -----  -----
Ada   NULL   R    
Ben   NULL   R

INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','1A',1),('03496','Clem','1B',15),('03505','Eva','1B',28),('03506','Gabe','1C',NULL),('03510','Finn','1B',7),('03513','Dio','1C',13),('03517','Ben','1A',9);

demo.note: Every existing record receives the default 'R'.

cards.en:
💡 The idea
Fixing a typo in a column heading. The data under the heading does not move.

📏 The rule
ALTER TABLE t RENAME COLUMN old TO new

  • Needs the words COLUMN and TO (unlike renaming a table in MySQL).
  • Type and constraints stay the same.
  • Saved queries using the old name must be updated, or they give 'unknown column' / 'no such column'.

📝 Exam wording
ALTER TABLE STUDENT RENAME COLUMN LAME TO NAME
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
修正栏位标题的错字，下面的数据不动。

📏 规则
ALTER TABLE t RENAME COLUMN 旧 TO 新

  • 要写 COLUMN 和 TO（MySQL 改表名不用）。
  • 类型和约束不变。
  • 用旧名的查询要更新，否则出现 'unknown column'。

📝 考试写法
ALTER TABLE STUDENT RENAME COLUMN LAME TO NAME

ex.q: Field LAME should be NAME. Fix it.
ex.a: ALTER TABLE STUDENT RENAME COLUMN LAME TO NAME
ex.az: RENAME COLUMN LAME TO NAME。

ex.q: After renaming, an old program runs SELECT LAME FROM STUDENT. Result?
ex.a: Error: no such column LAME. Update the program to use NAME.
ex.az: 出错，要改程序。

ex.q: Common mistake: ALTER TABLE STUDENT RENAME LAME NAME
ex.a: That is the table-rename pattern. For a field you need RENAME COLUMN … TO ….
ex.az: 那是改表名的写法。栏位要 RENAME COLUMN … TO。

code.out:
NAME
----
Ada 
Error: no such column: LAME
  SELECT LAME FROM STUDENT;
         ^--- error here

cards.en:
💡 The idea
Changing a column's type is like pouring water from a tall glass into a short cup: the DBMS tries to convert every value, and some may spill (be lost).

📏 The rule
MySQL: ALTER TABLE t MODIFY field type [constraints]

  • All values are converted: '03493' → 3493 (leading zeros trimmed).
  • A value that cannot convert (e.g. 'AC1389' → INT) makes the change fail.
  • MODIFY redefines the whole field: constraints not repeated (e.g. NOT NULL) are removed.
  • SQLite has no MODIFY (run=false below).

📝 Exam wording
When changing the data type of a field, the DBMS will also try to convert the data type of all values stored in that field. Such a conversion may result in data loss. If there is any value that cannot be converted properly, the change of data type will fail.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
改栏位类型像把高杯的水倒进矮杯：DBMS 会尝试转换每个值，有些可能“溢出”（丢失）。

📏 规则
MySQL：ALTER TABLE t MODIFY 栏位 类型 [约束]

  • 所有值会转换：'03493' → 3493（前导零被删）。
  • 有值不能转换（'AC1389' → INT）则修改失败。
  • MODIFY 重新定义整栏：没重写的约束（如 NOT NULL）会被移除。
  • SQLite 没有 MODIFY。

📝 考试写法
When changing the data type of a field, the DBMS will also try to convert the data type of all values stored in that field. Such a conversion may result in data loss. If there is any value that cannot be converted properly, the change of data type will fail.

ex.q: SID CHAR(5) holds '03493'. After ALTER TABLE STUDENT MODIFY SID INT, what is stored?
ex.a: 3493: the leading zero is lost.
ex.az: 3493，前导零丢失。

ex.q: PID holds 'AC1389'. What happens with MODIFY PID INT?
ex.a: 'AC1389' cannot become an integer → the change fails, data stays.
ex.az: 无法转换 → 修改失败。

ex.q: Common mistake: NAME was VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL; you run MODIFY NAME VARCHAR(60) to make it longer.
ex.a: NOT NULL is silently removed. Repeat it: MODIFY NAME VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL.
ex.az: NOT NULL 会被移除，要重写。

code.src:
ALTER TABLE STUDENT MODIFY SID INT;
SELECT SID, NAME FROM STUDENT WHERE NAME = 'Ada';

notes.t: MySQL: change SID from CHAR(5) to INT; zeros trimmed.

code.out:
Query OK, 7 rows affected
SID   NAME
3493  Ada

cards.en:
💡 The idea
Dropping a column is cutting a strip off every form with scissors. The data in that strip is gone for good; gluing a blank strip back does not bring it back.

📏 The rule
ALTER TABLE t DROP field (SQLite: DROP COLUMN)

  • All values in the field are deleted.
  • Adding a field with the same name back gives NULL/default, not the old data.
  • A field used in a key constraint may need the constraint dropped first.
  • Back up first.

📝 Exam wording
Once a field is deleted, all its values will be deleted as well. Adding back a field with the same name does not help.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
删栏位像用剪刀把每张表格剪掉一条：那条上的数据永远消失；再贴回空白条也找不回。

📏 规则
ALTER TABLE t DROP 栏位（SQLite：DROP COLUMN）

  • 该栏所有值被删除。
  • 再加同名栏位只得 NULL/默认值。
  • 用于键约束的栏位可能要先删约束。
  • 先备份。

📝 考试写法
Once a field is deleted, all its values will be deleted as well. Adding back a field with the same name does not help.

ex.q: Remove CNO from STUDENT.
ex.a: ALTER TABLE STUDENT DROP CNO
ex.az: DROP CNO。

ex.q: A club deletes HKID numbers for privacy. What should it check first?
ex.a: That no other process needs HKID (e.g. it is not a key or used in reports), and make a backup.
ex.az: 确认没有其他程序需要，并先备份。

ex.q: Common mistake: 'I dropped CNO by mistake, I'll just ADD CNO INT again.'
ex.a: The new CNO is all NULL; old numbers are lost. Only a backup restores them.
ex.az: 新的 CNO 全是 NULL，只有备份能救。

notes.t: Delete the field and its values.

code.out:
NAME  CNO 
----  ----
Clem  NULL
Eva   NULL
Finn  NULL
code.setup:
CREATE TABLE STUDENT (SID CHAR(5), NAME VARCHAR(16), CLASS CHAR(2), CNO INT);
INSERT INTO STUDENT VALUES ('03493','Ada','1A',1),('03496','Clem','1B',15),('03505','Eva','1B',28),('03506','Gabe','1C',NULL),('03510','Finn','1B',7),('03513','Dio','1C',13),('03517','Ben','1A',9);

cards.t: Adding and dropping a primary key
cards.en:
💡 The idea
You can add the 'ID card' rule later, but only if the existing data already obeys it: no repeats, no blanks.

📏 The rule
Add (MySQL):

  • ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD PRIMARY KEY (SID) (can do composite: (CLASS, CNO)).
  • ALTER TABLE STUDENT MODIFY SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY: needs the data type, cannot do composite.
Fails if any SID is duplicated or NULL.
Drop: ALTER TABLE STUDENT DROP PRIMARY KEY, no field name because there is only one primary key.

📝 Exam wording
When adding constraints, all existing data must not violate the constraints to be added, otherwise such an operation will fail. Since a table must not have more than one primary key, the name of the primary key field is not specified when dropping it.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
可以之后才加“身份证”规则，但现有数据必须已经符合：没重复、没空白。

📏 规则
新增（MySQL）：

  • ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD PRIMARY KEY (SID)（可复合）。
  • ALTER TABLE STUDENT MODIFY SID CHAR(5) PRIMARY KEY：要写类型，不能复合。
若 SID 有重复或 NULL 就失败。
删除：ALTER TABLE STUDENT DROP PRIMARY KEY，不用写栏位名，因为只有一个主键。

📝 考试写法
When adding constraints, all existing data must not violate the constraints to be added, otherwise such an operation will fail. 删除主键时 the name of the primary key field is not specified。

ex.q: Make (CLASS, CNO) the primary key of an existing table.
ex.a: Only ADD can do composite: ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD PRIMARY KEY (CLASS, CNO)
ex.az: 用 ADD PRIMARY KEY (CLASS, CNO)。

ex.q: Gabe's CNO is NULL. Will ADD PRIMARY KEY (CLASS, CNO) work?
ex.a: No: a primary key cannot contain NULL. Fill Gabe's CNO first.
ex.az: 不行：有 NULL。先补上。

ex.q: Common mistake: ALTER TABLE STUDENT DROP PRIMARY KEY SID
ex.a: Do not name the field; just DROP PRIMARY KEY.
ex.az: 不要写栏位名。

notes.t: MySQL: SID becomes the primary key (all SIDs unique, none NULL).
Remove it again; no field name needed.

notes.tz: 失败：Gabe 的 CNO 是 NULL。

code.out:
Query OK, 7 rows affected
Query OK, 7 rows affected
ERROR 1138 (22004): Invalid use of NULL value

cards.t: Misconception: adding a new PRIMARY KEY field to a filled table
cards.tz: 误解：在已有数据的表加新主键栏位
cards.en:
💡 The idea
Imagine 500 members and you announce 'everyone now has a membership number' but nobody is given one. They all have the same blank number, which breaks the 'no repeats' rule.

📏 The rule
ALTER TABLE BOOKCLUB ADD MEMID INT PRIMARY KEY on 500 records fails:

  • The new field would be NULL, or the DBMS default (0) for all records.
  • Either NULL or 500 duplicates → violates PRIMARY KEY.
Safe way: ADD the field without the constraint → fill unique values with UPDATE → ADD PRIMARY KEY (or use AUTO_INCREMENT, which numbers existing rows).

📝 Exam wording
The PRIMARY KEY constraint forbids the value of a primary key to be NULL or duplicated; all existing records would get the same value (NULL/0), so the statement cannot be executed.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
想像有 500 名会员，你宣布“人人都有会员号”却没发号码：全部都是同一个空号码，违反“不重复”。

📏 规则
在 500 条记录上执行 ALTER TABLE BOOKCLUB ADD MEMID INT PRIMARY KEY 会失败：

  • 新栏会是 NULL，或默认值 0。
  • NULL 或 500 个重复 → 违反主键。
安全做法：先加栏位（不加约束）→ 用 UPDATE 填唯一值 → 再 ADD PRIMARY KEY（或用 AUTO_INCREMENT 自动编号）。

📝 考试写法
The PRIMARY KEY constraint forbids the value of a primary key to be NULL or duplicated；所有现有记录会得到同一值，所以不能执行。

ex.q: Checkpoint 1.5(b): Can the statement run on BOOKCLUB with 500+ records? Explain.
ex.a: No. MEMID would be NULL (or the same default 0) for every record, but a primary key cannot be NULL or duplicated.
ex.az: 不能：全部 NULL 或同为 0，违反主键。

ex.q: Give the safe 3-step method.
ex.a:
1. ALTER TABLE BOOKCLUB ADD MEMID INT
2. UPDATE … to give each member a unique MEMID
3. ALTER TABLE BOOKCLUB ADD PRIMARY KEY (MEMID)
ex.az: 加栏 → 填唯一值 → 加主键。

ex.q: Common mistake: 'It works if we add DEFAULT 1.'
ex.a: Every record gets 1 → 500 duplicates → still fails.
ex.az: 全部都是 1 → 仍然重复。

notes.t: Small stand-in for the club table.
Step 1: add the field, no constraint.
Step 2: give each a unique number.
Check: all unique, so step 3 (ADD PRIMARY KEY) would now work in MySQL.
notes.tz: 检查：全部唯一，可进行步骤 3。

cards.t: Adding and dropping foreign keys; SHOW CREATE TABLE
cards.tz: 新增与删除外键；SHOW CREATE TABLE
cards.en:
💡 The idea
A table can have several links (foreign keys), so to cut one you need its name tag. SHOW CREATE TABLE shows you the name tags.

📏 The rule

  • Add: ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD FOREIGN KEY (CLASS) REFERENCES CLASSLIST(CLASS). Fails if any existing CLASS value is not in CLASSLIST.
  • Find the name: SHOW CREATE TABLE STUDENT → e.g. CONSTRAINT `student_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY ….
  • Drop: ALTER TABLE STUDENT DROP FOREIGN KEY STUDENT_IBFK_1.

📝 Exam wording
Since there can be more than one foreign key in a table, when dropping a foreign key, we need to specify which one to drop.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
一个表可有多条连结（外键），要剪断其中一条就要知道它的名牌。SHOW CREATE TABLE 会显示名牌。

📏 规则

  • 新增：ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD FOREIGN KEY (CLASS) REFERENCES CLASSLIST(CLASS)；若现有 CLASS 有值不在 CLASSLIST 就失败。
  • 找名称：SHOW CREATE TABLE STUDENT → 例如 CONSTRAINT `student_ibfk_1` …。
  • 删除：ALTER TABLE STUDENT DROP FOREIGN KEY STUDENT_IBFK_1。

📝 考试写法
Since there can be more than one foreign key in a table, when dropping a foreign key, we need to specify which one to drop.

ex.q: STUDENT has a student in class '1E', but CLASSLIST has only 1A–1D. Will ADD FOREIGN KEY (CLASS) … work?
ex.a: No: '1E' does not exist in the parent. Fix that record first.
ex.az: 不行：1E 不存在。先修正。

ex.q: Steps to drop the foreign key on CLASS.
ex.a:
1. SHOW CREATE TABLE STUDENT → find the constraint name, e.g. student_ibfk_1.
2. ALTER TABLE STUDENT DROP FOREIGN KEY STUDENT_IBFK_1.
ex.az: 先查名称，再 DROP FOREIGN KEY 名称。

ex.q: Common mistake: ALTER TABLE STUDENT DROP FOREIGN KEY CLASS
ex.a: CLASS is the field, not the constraint name. Use the name from SHOW CREATE TABLE.
ex.az: CLASS 是栏位名，不是约束名称。

notes.t: Show the CREATE statement with the constraint name.
notes.tz: 显示含约束名称的语句。

notes.t: Drop that foreign key by name.

code.out:
Query OK, 7 rows affected
... CONSTRAINT `student_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`CLASS`) REFERENCES `classlist` (`CLASS`) ...
Query OK, 0 rows affected

cards.en:
💡 The idea
Each constraint has its own 'switch'. Learn the pattern, not every line: NOT NULL by redefining the field, DEFAULT by ALTER … SET/DROP, UNIQUE dropped as an index, CHECK dropped by name.

📏 The rule
KeywordAddDrop
NOT NULLMODIFY NAME CHAR(16) NOT NULLMODIFY NAME CHAR(16)
UNIQUEADD UNIQUE(EMAIL)DROP INDEX EMAIL
DEFAULTALTER NAME SET DEFAULT 'John'ALTER NAME DROP DEFAULT
CHECKADD CHECK (CNO > 0)DROP CHECK STUDENT_CHK_1
(each starts with ALTER TABLE STUDENT). SQLite cannot do these with ALTER TABLE.

📝 Exam wording
Adding fails if existing data violates the constraint; e.g. ADD CHECK (CNO > 0) fails if some CNO is 0 or negative.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
每种约束有自己的“开关”。记规律：NOT NULL 用重新定义栏位；DEFAULT 用 ALTER … SET/DROP；UNIQUE 以 index 删除；CHECK 用名称删除。

📏 规则
关键字新增删除
NOT NULLMODIFY NAME CHAR(16) NOT NULLMODIFY NAME CHAR(16)
UNIQUEADD UNIQUE(EMAIL)DROP INDEX EMAIL
DEFAULTALTER NAME SET DEFAULT 'John'ALTER NAME DROP DEFAULT
CHECKADD CHECK (CNO > 0)DROP CHECK STUDENT_CHK_1
（前面都是 ALTER TABLE STUDENT）。SQLite 不能用 ALTER TABLE 做这些。

📝 考试写法
若现有数据违反约束，新增会失败；例如有 CNO ≤ 0 时 ADD CHECK (CNO > 0) 失败。

ex.q: Make EMAIL unique, then remove that rule.
ex.a:
ALTER TABLE STUDENT ADD UNIQUE(EMAIL)
ALTER TABLE STUDENT DROP INDEX EMAIL
ex.az: ADD UNIQUE(EMAIL)；DROP INDEX EMAIL。

ex.q: Set the default HOUSE to 'G'.
ex.a: ALTER TABLE STUDENT ALTER HOUSE SET DEFAULT 'G'
ex.az: ALTER HOUSE SET DEFAULT 'G'。

ex.q: Common mistake: ALTER TABLE STUDENT DROP NOT NULL NAME
ex.a: No such syntax. Remove NOT NULL by redefining the field without it: MODIFY NAME CHAR(16).
ex.az: 没有这种语法，用 MODIFY 重新定义。

notes.t: Drop the CHECK by its name.

cards.en:
💡 The idea
A website adds membership levels. Storing level names as text looks easy, but sorting goes A→Z, not by level. Example 1.5 walks through the fix.

📏 The rule
USER(UID, USERNAME, CREDIT).

  1. (a) ALTER TABLE USER ADD MTYPE CHAR(7) DEFAULT 'Regular'
  2. (b) UPDATE USER SET MTYPE = 'Bronze' WHERE MTYPE = 'Premium'
  3. (c) SELECT * FROM USER ORDER BY MTYPE gives Bronze, Gold, Regular, Silver: alphabetical, not level order.
  4. (d) Create MTYPELIST(TID 0–3, TNAME); ALTER TABLE USER MODIFY MTYPE INT
  5. (e) ALTER TABLE USER ADD FOREIGN KEY (MTYPE) REFERENCES MTYPELIST(TID)

📝 Exam wording
Character strings are sorted in alphabetical order, so Regular, Bronze, Silver, Gold are not sorted by level; storing the type as an integer ID referring to MTYPELIST solves this.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
网站加入会员等级。用文字存等级名看似简单，但排序会按字母，不按等级。Example 1.5 示范如何修正。

📏 规则
USER(UID, USERNAME, CREDIT)。

  1. (a) ALTER TABLE USER ADD MTYPE CHAR(7) DEFAULT 'Regular'
  2. (b) UPDATE USER SET MTYPE = 'Bronze' WHERE MTYPE = 'Premium'
  3. (c) ORDER BY MTYPE 得 Bronze, Gold, Regular, Silver：按字母，不是等级。
  4. (d) 建 MTYPELIST(TID 0–3, TNAME)；MODIFY MTYPE INT
  5. (e) ADD FOREIGN KEY (MTYPE) REFERENCES MTYPELIST(TID)

📝 考试写法
Character strings are sorted in alphabetical order，所以等级不能按 Regular→Gold 排；改为整数 ID 参照 MTYPELIST 就解决。

ex.q: (a) What MTYPE do the existing users get?
ex.a: 'Regular', from DEFAULT.
ex.az: 默认 'Regular'。

ex.q: Sort users from Regular (0) up to Gold (3) after the redesign.
ex.a: SELECT * FROM USER ORDER BY MTYPE now sorts 0,1,2,3 = Regular, Bronze, Silver, Gold.
ex.az: 改为整数后按 0–3 排序。

ex.q: Common mistake: (b) UPDATE USER SET MTYPE = 'Bronze' with no WHERE.
ex.a: Every user becomes Bronze, including Regular ones. Add WHERE MTYPE = 'Premium'.
ex.az: 没有 WHERE：全部变 Bronze。

code.out:
USERNAME  MTYPE  
--------  -------
momo      Bronze 
kitty     Gold   
nana      Regular
leo       Silver
code.setup: CREATE TABLE USER (UID CHAR(8) PRIMARY KEY, USERNAME VARCHAR(40), CREDIT FLOAT); INSERT INTO USER VALUES ('U0000001','kitty',20),('U0000002','leo',5.5),('U0000003','momo',0),('U0000004','nana',12);

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE USER (UID CHAR(8) PRIMARY KEY, USERNAME VARCHAR(40), CREDIT FLOAT); INSERT INTO USER VALUES ('U0000001','kitty',20),('U0000002','leo',5.5),('U0000003','momo',0),('U0000004','nana',12);ALTER TABLE USER ADD COLUMN MTYPE CHAR(7) DEFAULT 'Regular'; UPDATE USER SET MTYPE='Gold' WHERE UID='U0000001'; UPDATE USER SET MTYPE='Silver' WHERE UID='U0000002'; UPDATE USER SET MTYPE='Bronze' WHERE UID='U0000003';
demo.query: SELECT USERNAME, MTYPE FROM USER ORDER BY MTYPE
demo.note: Bronze, Gold, Regular, Silver: sorted A→Z, not Regular→Bronze→Silver→Gold.

cards.t: Numbers stored as strings sort wrongly
cards.tz: 数字存成字符串会排错
cards.en:
💡 The idea
Sorting words in a dictionary compares the first letter first. '11' starts with '1', '7' starts with '7', so as text '7' is 'bigger' than '11'.

📏 The rule
Chapter Exercise 3: PLAYER has SCORE1 CHAR(2).

  • ORDER BY SCORE1 DESC gives 7, 11, 1, -4.
  • Fix: change to a numeric type: MySQL ALTER TABLE PLAYER MODIFY SCORE1 INT (in SQLite you can test with ORDER BY CAST(SCORE1 AS INTEGER)).

📝 Exam wording
SCORE1 is a character string, so it is sorted in alphabetical (character) order, not numeric order.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
字典排序先比第一个字。'11' 开头是 '1'，'7' 开头是 '7'，所以当成文字时 '7' 比 '11' “大”。

📏 规则
Chapter Exercise 3：PLAYER 的 SCORE1 是 CHAR(2)。

  • ORDER BY SCORE1 DESC 得 7, 11, 1, -4。
  • 修正：改数字类型，MySQL MODIFY SCORE1 INT（SQLite 可用 CAST(SCORE1 AS INTEGER) 测试）。

📝 考试写法
SCORE1 is a character string, so it is sorted in alphabetical (character) order, not numeric order.

ex.q: As strings, which is larger: '9' or '10'?
ex.a: Compare first characters: '9' > '1' → '9' is larger.

ex.q: Why is player 002 (score 11) not first in DESC order?
ex.a: '11' starts with '1', which is smaller than '7', so string order puts '7' first.

ex.q: Common mistake: fixing it by sorting ASC instead of DESC.
ex.a: Still string order (-4, 1, 11, 7). The real fix is a numeric data type.
ex.az: 仍是字符串次序，要改成数字类型。

code.src:
SELECT PID, SCORE1 FROM PLAYER ORDER BY SCORE1 DESC;
SELECT PID, SCORE1 FROM PLAYER ORDER BY CAST(SCORE1 AS INTEGER) DESC

notes.tz: 字符串次序：7 在 11 前。

code.setup: CREATE TABLE PLAYER (PID CHAR(3) PRIMARY KEY, SCORE1 CHAR(2)); INSERT INTO PLAYER VALUES ('001','7'),('002','11'),('003','1'),('004','-4');

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE PLAYER (PID CHAR(3) PRIMARY KEY, SCORE1 CHAR(2)); INSERT INTO PLAYER VALUES ('001','7'),('002','11'),('003','1'),('004','-4');
demo.query: SELECT PID, SCORE1 FROM PLAYER ORDER BY SCORE1 DESC
demo.note: Text sorting compares character by character, so '7' beats '11'.

cards.en:
💡 The idea
If an absent player is automatically given 0, you can't tell them apart from a player who came and scored 0. NULL keeps 'absent' different from 'zero'.

📏 The rule
Chapter Exercise 3(d): players present in both rounds get a consolation prize.

  • Default 0 → absent = scored 0 → prize can't be decided.
  • Default NULL → absent players have NULL; WHERE SCORE1 IS NOT NULL AND SCORE2 IS NOT NULL finds those present in both.

📝 Exam wording
A score of 0 is a valid score. If the default were 0, an absent player could not be distinguished from a present player who scored 0.
cards.zh:
💡 直觉
若缺席球员自动得 0 分，就无法分辨他和出席但得 0 分的人。NULL 令“缺席”与“零分”不同。

📏 规则
Chapter Exercise 3(d)：两轮都出席的球员有安慰奖。

  • 默认 0 → 缺席等同 0 分 → 无法判断。
  • 默认 NULL → 缺席是 NULL；WHERE SCORE1 IS NOT NULL AND SCORE2 IS NOT NULL 找出两轮都出席的人。

📝 考试写法
A score of 0 is a valid score. If the default were 0, an absent player could not be distinguished from a present player who scored 0.

ex.q: Should SCORE1 default to 0? Answer in exam style.
ex.a: No. 0 is a valid score; with default 0, an absent player could not be distinguished from a present player scoring 0.
ex.az: 不应该：0 是有效分数。

ex.q: Write SQL for players present in both rounds.
ex.a: SELECT PID FROM PLAYER WHERE SCORE1 IS NOT NULL AND SCORE2 IS NOT NULL
ex.az: 两栏都 IS NOT NULL。

ex.q: Common mistake: WHERE SCORE1 <> NULL
ex.a: Comparison with NULL is never true → no rows. Use IS NOT NULL.
ex.az: 与 NULL 比较永不成立，要用 IS NOT NULL。
